inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Franchise Tax Delinquent: The operations franchise tax filing status has not been corrected by the due date and is still showing Franchise tax involuntarily ended as of 7/20/2026
occurrences.violation_type_title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The transportation vehicle that is currently being used does not have a child safety alarm installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The staff and director's attendance record were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Franchise Tax Delinquent: The operations franchise tax filing status is showing Franchise tax involuntarily ended as of 6/26/2026
occurrences.violation_type_title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The documentation for the  fire inspection report was not available for review
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Multiple ceiling tiles were observed damaged and drooping to the point were the ceiling has an exposed gap or hole.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: A spray bottle of Lysol was observed on top of a wooden shelf in the cafeteria and accessible to children.     This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver in charge removed the Lysol away from the children and placed it were it cannot be reached.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: A staff member who is no longer with the operation has not been inactivated within seven days of leaving
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two children files did not have a copy of their shot record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Three files reviewed did not have an address for their emergency contact information.     Note: This was corrected when the caregiver in charge was able to contact parents and get the addresses.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Front room: There is a whole in the wall close to the floor. The paint is chipping on the wall near the kitchen area.     School age room: Paint chipping in the room.    Middle room: The carpet is shredded on the stage area.    Toddler room: There is a nail sticking out of the door frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Four children files reviewed did not have health statements in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: Two cars and a school bus did not have the required use zone.    Note: The caregiver moved the items around to allow for the required use zone space in between.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on the information obtained during the investigation conducted by DFPS, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation that children are being inappropriately disciplined.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: In the toddler classroom, a medium sized hole was observed on the floor, posing a risk to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A fifth teen year old child who is enrolled at the operation does not have a background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection: The sanitation report was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3403)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was observed by herself in the school age classroom with a mixed group of twenty-eight children. The youngest child was three and the oldest child was fifteen. The specified age group was three.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: Two fans were observed sitting on top of a table next to children. The fans were not anchored or safe guarded.     This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver removed the fans.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: A school age caregiver with an ineligible background check was seen caring for children   This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver left the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: One caregiver was observed supervising an infant classroom and supervising a toddler classroom. There was a door between both classroom's and the caregiver was standing in between both rooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Multiple school age children were observed playing Roblox on there tablets. There was also other children observed watching a cartoon on TV that was not educational. Also children in the toddler classroom were watching television that was not educational or apart of daily activities.     This was corrected during the inspection when the children put there tablets away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: All thirty hour's of the directors trainings were presented by the director and were not instructor led or self instructional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A five month old infant was observed sleeping in a bouncer seat.     This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver removed the infant from the bouncer and placed the infant in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: An infant caregiver with an ineligible background was seen caring for infants.     This was corrected when the caregiver left the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
